mapper.select: select wx_dept_id from ${table} where corpid = #{corpid} and wx_dept_id = #{wxDeptId} and type = #{type}
mapper.insert: insert into ${table} (corpid, wx_dept_id, dept_name, parent_id, status, last_sync_time, type) values (#{e.corpid}, #{e.wxDeptId}, #{e.deptName}, #{e.parentId}, #{e.status}, #{e.lastSyncTime}, #{e.type})
